description: Curated controlled retrieval benchmark for graph expansion versus vector-only retrieval. Natural-language embeddings use the production all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ONNX provider; recognition-memory seed selection is deterministic to remove external Gemini variance.

queries.text: Where does Project Atlas ultimately persist its audit records?
Which technology stores the audit records produced by Project Atlas?
Follow Project Atlas's processing chain: what backend holds the audit records?

passages.content: Project Atlas routes its audit records through the Quill component.
Quill persists audit records in PostgreSQL for durable storage.
